info.title: Gridly Universal API
info.description: Gridly is a localization and structured content platform for managing projects, databases, grids, views, records, glossaries, translation memories, automations, and delivery workflows through a REST API.

post.description: Creates a new column in a Gridly view.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

viewId.description: The unique identifier of the view where the column should be created.

name.description: The display name of the column to create.

type.description: The Gridly column type to create.

id.description: An optional explicit column ID to assign when creating the column.

languageCode.description: A language code for language columns.

localizationType.description: The localization role for language columns, such as sourceLanguage or targetLanguage.

selection.description: Selection options for singleSelection or multipleSelections columns.

editable.description: Whether the column is editable in the view.

isSource.description: Whether the column is a source column.

isTarget.description: Whether the column is a target column.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
